profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, tagged telecom=data_center, is named "Factory Software | AVEVA Select Italia." AVEVA is a real, publicly traded industrial software company, listed on the London Stock Exchange, that provides engineering design, operations management, and asset-performance software used across manufacturing, energy, and process industries worldwide. "AVEVA Select" is the branding AVEVA uses for its network of regional reseller and systems-integrator partners, and this record most plausibly identifies an Italian partner office selling and supporting AVEVA's software products under that program, likely operating under the name "Factory Software" as the local reseller entity. A software reseller and integrator's office maintains its own business IT systems but is not a data-center operator; the telecom=data_center tag here is best read as a mistag of the office's own server or IT closet.

reading.body:
This entry is a mistag: a software reseller's office in Italy, not a data center, and therefore contributes zero megawatts to AI infrastructure.

Factory Software operates as an AVEVA Select partner, meaning it resells and integrates industrial software for a publicly traded company whose products serve manufacturing, energy, and process industries. The office maintains its own IT systems to run its business, including servers or a small closet rack. Someone tagged this location as a data center in OpenStreetMap, likely because any organization with on-premise servers can appear similar in satellite imagery or records to actual operators.

The distinction matters for tracking AI's power footprint. A reseller's office and a data center differ by orders of magnitude in electricity consumption and facility design. This entry documents how misclassification can dilute counts of actual infrastructure. The 0 megawatts assigned here correctly reflects that no hyperscale compute lives here, only the ordinary IT backbone of a software business.

The record does not identify any data centers in Italy, does not measure power consumption at this location, and does not reveal where AVEVA's actual compute infrastructure sits. It only clarifies what this single point is not.
